tool_input.description: Inspect repo layout, CI config, and tally pass/fail per runner

result:
- **Cause:** runner-03 is slow for this test; the MR's change is not the cause. In the Xping history every failure of this test comes from one machine (7 runs, same signature). Both runner-03 runs in the visible history failed, including one on `main` at 32f21f2, which doesn't contain this change. The same commit (aece513) passed locally in 136 ms, and the test passes on runners 01, 02, 04, 05 and 06. The test writes 1000 files, so slow disk on runner-03 is the likely reason, though I couldn't confirm that from here.

- **Action:** I changed nothing. The MR only adds one optional line per invoice, and raising the 250 ms budget enough to pass on runner-03 (over 450 ms) would stop the test catching real slowdowns. To get green, retry the `test` job so it lands on another runner. I couldn't do that from here because the repo has no git remote configured.

Until someone fixes or pauses runner-03, this test will keep failing for any MR whose job lands there.
